title: Mission Control - Launch Calibration Sheet
summary: Compact, operational calibration sheet used in the 72h prelaunch window to align traffic, capacity, KPI thresholds, and go/no-go signals across product, infra, and CS for small-to-medium feature rollouts.

go_no_go_signals:
Hard stop signals (any = block): 1) p95 latency > 320ms sustained 15m; 2) 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained 15m; 3) Error budget burn > 30% vs predicted for the day; 4) Canary retention drop > 8pp vs baseline.
Soft signals (require mitigation plan before proceed): 1) token consumption > 20% above forecast; 2) intermittent timeouts <=5% with root-cause identified; 3) non-critical feature telemetry missing - must add patch within 12h.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risks and mitigations (short bullets):
- Burst traffic overshoot: mitigation = pre-authorize burst quota + auto-fallback to smaller model variant + cache warmup
- KV cache thrash on long-tail prompts: mitigation = increase prefix cache retention for canary cohort + monitor miss rate
- Customer data in private deploy: mitigation = verify KMS rotation, run compliance checklist, limit sample exports
- Observability gaps: mitigation = enable tracing sampling at 100% for canary traffic, extra retention for token-level logs (48h)
notes: Context and decisions: this sheet is optimized for medium-sized launches (10k-200k daily tokens early runway). For enterprise Dedicated launches, duplicate and expand capacity rows into per-customer pools. Use Launch Dashboard (Confluence link above) for dashboards; this sheet is the operational single source during the t-minus window. Refer to 'throughput-economics-roadmap-dedicated-hosted' model for costing assumptions.
